* A collection of bytes in memory. * *

Moving data from one buffer to another is fast. Instead * of copying bytes from one place in memory to another, this class just changes * ownership of the underlying byte arrays. * *

This buffer grows with your data. Just like ArrayList, * each buffer starts small. It consumes only the memory it needs to. * *

This buffer pools its byte arrays. When you allocate a * byte array in Java, the runtime must zero-fill the requested array before * returning it to you. Even if you're going to write over that space anyway. * This class avoids zero-fill and GC churn by pooling byte arrays. * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API
